note: Not a knob: the file bin/merge-conductor-pr.sh hands the keyed conductor run on a lane-run machine (BH-6495). With MC_ON_MACHINE=1, mc_defer_word (bin/lib/mc/log.sh, BH-7635) appends the name of each step that needs the hub (land, rebase, rereview) to it, and bin/merge-conductor-pr.sh reports them. Read as ${MC_PR_DEFERRED_FILE:-}; empty = nothing is written. A path, so NOT settable from the control plane.
